kenshi: 株数断絶: 4:1株式分割を2回(2021/12・2024/12)。shW 2018:74.8→2019:305→2025:1,258百万株、shOut 2025:1,259百万株。eps2.79・dilNetは全て分割後基準。分割前後の株数を直接比較禁止
NetIncomeLossのXBRLタグがFY2021-2025で0.0=タグ破損/不発見。よってkenshi_helperのFCF/accr(-22.5%)は棄却。NIは eps2.79×希薄化株~1,258百万 ≈ 3.5十億USD、かつ accr恒等式(NI=OCF4,372+(-4.4%×資産19,449)=3,516百万)とも整合 → ni=3.5十億USDを充填
gm訂正: ドラフトgm=42.8は営業利益率(op3,856/rev9,003=42.8%)。GrossProfitタグは存在(FY2025=5.8十億, gpa=29.7の基礎)ゆえ真の粗利率=5.8/9.0=64.4% → gm=64.4に訂正
capex: PaymentsToAcquirePPEタグがFY2019で途切れ(以降不発見)。FY2025 capex再現不能 → fcf=null(誤値より空欄)。OCF=4,372百万・資本軽量業態ゆえ質的にはFCF≒OCF
ROIC検算: kenshi 5年(2021-25) 込み18.4/24.7/24.7/23.3/30.1%・除き19.3/26.1/25.7/23.9/31.4%、σ=3.7pt。ドラフトroic27.3/roicg25.8は範囲内(IC/税率定義差)→維持。のれん込みROIC≫WACC
sbc充填: ShareBasedCompensation FY2025=439.2百万 → 0.44十億USD。nde検算: 純負債(-cash1,964)/EBITDA ≈ -0.5=純現金・ドラフト整合
顧客集中(集): 2社で42%(26%+16%, 2025)、単一最大26%。推移は一社21→15→16%低下・他社18→20→26%上昇の混在。geopol=2。dilNet=59.98は分割断絶で独立再現困難のため採取器値を維持

evidence.expiry: 『trademark laws and confidentiality agreements... offer only limited protection』『we may choose not to seek patent protection for certain innovations』→堀は特許/コンセッションの期限依存ではない=no
evidence.moatdecay: 『continued growth in initial and renewal support contracts as our customer installed base has continued to expand』(2025 vs 2024)+粗利率up・ROIC up・売上CAGR31%→構造的減衰なし=no
evidence.erosion: 『The arrival of new market entrants and the rapid adoption of alternative technologies may create downward pricing pressure』『we may lose our competitive position』→新規参入・値下げ圧力の萌芽=emerging
evidence.disrupt: 『these markets may experience significant fluctuations... prolonged slowdowns, cyclical contractions, or the correction of speculative bubbles』『rapid adoption of alternative technologies』=技術代替が未決着=unsettled(名指しの決定的代替はなし)
evidence.dom: 『The data center and campus networking [market]』の競争・値下げ圧力の枠組み+『a limited number of customers... significant portion of our revenue』。hitsに明示シェア%なし→寡占参加者として保守的に70(明示シェア欠落を注記)
evidence.irr: 『continued growth in initial and renewal support contracts as our customer installed base has continued to expand』→更新契約・据付基盤による移行摩擦=高摩擦=70(認証・規格ロックの明示証拠はなし)
evidence.rep: 『all of which offer only limited protection... we may not be able to prosecute all necessary or desirable patent applications』→IP保護は限定的。据付基盤/ソフトで複製は困難だが複製不能とは言えず=60
evidence.dur: 据付基盤+更新サポート契約による乗り換え費用が堀の核=スイッチングコスト=75
evidence.geopol: 『Two of our customers accounted for more than 10% of our sales... 26% and 16% of our total revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025』+『sole source suppliers』→顧客・供給集中=重=2
evidence.p2: COVID(上場後唯一の景気後退): 営利2019 805.8→2020 699.7百万=-13%=浅い(-20%以内)→95。ただし2008以前は上場前で単一サイクル標本。循セクションが構造的cyclicalityを強調(要監視)
evidence.p3: nde=-0.5=純現金(有利子負債ほぼ皆無・cash1,964百万)→95
evidence.p4: 『material weakness』ヒットは監査手続の定型文(『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists』)で実指摘ではない。『Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments... Not applicable』+accr=-4.4%(<0)→90
evidence.f2: 『our plan to expand and deepen our market share in our existing markets and possibly expand into additional markets』+AI/データセンタ networking の初期浸透。hitsに明示TAM%なし→保守側で90-80帯の下限=80
evidence.f3: シェア趨勢+(『customer installed base has continued to expand』)は明確。R&D/売上の符号はhitsに数値なし→片方確認=75。顧客集中は増減混在ゆえ-10は不適用
evidence.f4: 『In the NDR market, our Arista...』+『data center and campus networking』=NDR/campus等の隣接を育成中(売上5%超の明示開示はhitsになし)=60
evidence.moatW: セグメント別売上(FY2025 10-K, 総額9,005.7百万$): 報告セグメントは1つ(『Number of reportable segments 1』)。地域別のみ開示で米州7,122.1=79.1% / EMEA 1,070.3=11.9% / アジア太平洋813.3=9.0%(うち米国7,063.8=78.4%)(出典: 10-K 2025-12-31 Segment and Geographical Information R60)。製品は単一のクラウドネットワーキング(EOS+イーサネットスイッチ)一本で製品ライン別売上の開示なし。顧客集中は原本明記: 『Two of our customers accounted for more than 10% of our sales for the year ended December 31, 2025. Sales to these two customers represented 26% and 16% of our total revenue』『sales to one end customer represented 16%, 15%, and 21% ... the other end customer represented 26%, 20%, and 18% of our total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023』『our top two resellers accounted for 52% and 50% of total accounts receivable』。→ 単一製品・単一用途かつ最大顧客26%≥20%。独立した堀は1本で刻み50と判定
